title: Clarity Pane Component and Figure Labeling System for Cost Breakdowns
creator: Lena Ortiz
description: Problem: Cost breakdown views in the Console currently mix compact numeric tiles, free-form tooltips, and inconsistent figure labels (e.g. 'Est. cost', 'Projected spend', '$/token') which causes confusion when users pivot between per-route and per-model views. Goal: Design a reusable 'Clarity Pane' component (compact side panel, expandable) and an associated figure-labeling token system that standardizes how monetary and rate figures are shown across dashboards, rollouts, and cost explorers. Scope: component anatomy (header, primary figure, delta, small-print metadata), token mapping (type, scale, unit, tone), responsive states (collapsed/expanded), and Figma library updates. Out-of-scope: billing backend changes, pricing model alterations.
acceptance_criteria: Figma component set merged into Console design library with variant states (collapsed/expanded/loading/error)
Label token taxonomy documented and added to tokens spreadsheet with usage examples for cost-per-token, hourly capacity, and aggregated spend
Developer handoff includes CSS token mapping and a small React demo page that shows all states (link provided)
Accessibility audit completed: numeric figures expose aria-labels and the pane passes contrast and screen-reader checks
PM sign-off on the wording glossary for 'estimate' vs 'projected' vs 'actual' labels
comments: 2026-03-01 - Initial spike: built three conceptual layouts (tile, rail, pane). Team favored the pane because it scales vertically and maps to existing rollout inspector patterns.
2026-03-04 - PM review (Marco Chen): asked to avoid 'Est.' abbreviation in primary figure — requested full wording options and a glossary of terms for localization.

2026-03-07 - Engineering sync (R&D): discussed token mapping constraints for small-print metadata; decided to add a dedicated numeric-size token and a compact-line-height group to avoid layout jitter.

2026-03-10 - Accessibility pass (Liaison: Naomi Price): flagged color ramp for delta badges; recommended stronger semantic color tokens and explicit aria-label patterns for deltas (e.g. 'increase of 12% last 24h').

2026-03-12 - Proto usability test (5 participants): users preferred pane with emphasized primary figure and contextual microcopy; two participants were confused by 'per request' vs 'per token' unit naming — added to wording glossary.
2026-03-14 - Design review: consolidated feedback and prepared export-ready token map for dev handoff. Ready for engineering review and paired handoff session.
decisions: Choose a dedicated 'clarity-primary' token for headline numeric type (size and weight) to ensure consistency across dashboards
Introduce 'figure-unit' token family that separates semantic unit (currency, tokens, requests) from formatting rules
Adopt explicit wording glossary entries (Estimate, Projection, Actual) and require PM approval for label changes
Pane will default collapsed on narrow screens and expand in desktop wide-breakpoints; collapsed shows primary figure + chevron
next_steps: Pairing session with ENG (Rajiv) to walk token exports and variant props - schedule for 2026-03-16
Produce text-only glossary artifact for localization and pass to i18n team
Add prototype screenshots to Confluence PRD and attach the demo React sandbox
Open follow-up ENG tickets for instrumentation and telemetry to capture user collapse/expand metrics
